interest: Shows American Kenneth Dawson's 1933 bid to enlist in Japan's army as a path to naturalization abroad.
overview: Letter (1933): American Kenneth Dawson of Miami asks State to help him renounce US citizenship and naturalize in Japan or French Indochina, having applied to enlist in Japan's army as an inducement.

people.name: Kenneth Dawson
people.role: American citizen and former seaman seeking foreign naturalization and enlistment

subfiles.about: An American citizen writes to the State Department seeking assistance and foreign consular cooperation to naturalize in Japan or French Indochina and enlist in the Japanese Army.
subfiles.summary: Dawson asks State to help him naturalize in Japan or French Indochina, having applied to both embassies and sought enlistment in Japan's army to gain entry and citizenship.
subfiles.title: Letter from Kenneth Dawson requesting assistance to naturalize in Japan or French Indochina and enlist in the Japanese Army
subfiles.to: Office of the Consul General, Department of State
